Name: Garden Village Retexture
Author: zilchaz
Description:
Redesign store facade for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12474]Garden Village Shops for CP[/url].



This mod also adds stone floor color-matching with some recolored mod:
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255/]Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url]
[*]will add some more later...
[/list]

-
[b]Installation:[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod required [u]Garden Village﻿ Shops for CP[/u].
[*]Drop the content of this zip file in your [u]Mods[/u] folder.
[/list]
